description: This file defines the class `HTMLPurifier_StringHashParser`, which is responsible for parsing string hash configuration files in various formats, including single or multiple string hashes. It provides methods to parse individual files or multi-file hashes with delimiters, and contains internal logic to process file handle streams.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_StringHashParser
classes.description: A class for parsing string hash files with support for multiple formats, including handling of multi-line values and delimiters.

methods.name: parseFile
methods.description: Parses a single string-hash from a specified file, returning an associative array.

methods.name: parseMultiFile
methods.description: Parses multiple string-hashes from a file where each hash is delimited by '----'.

methods.name: parseHandle
methods.description: Internal method that processes a file handle to extract the string hash data, supporting multi-line and comment handling.

search-terms: PHP class for parsing hash files
